findings.claim: 全球太陽能模組產能在2025年已達約800GW，遠超過同年約450GW的新增裝機量，供過於求局面延續
findings.source: TheEnergyBrief - PV Module Manufacturers' New Reality 2026
findings.excerpt: total global PV module capacity reached approximately 800 GW in 2025, while global new installations that year were only about 450 GW

findings.claim: 中國龍頭LONGi與Jinko仍持續擴大電池產能，LONGi的HPBC電池產能預計2026年底達50GW、Jinko的N型TOPCon產能超過60GW，顯示同業並未收縮新產能
findings.source: TheEnergyBrief - PV Module Manufacturers' New Reality 2026
findings.excerpt: LONGi Green Energy's HPBC cell capacity expected to reach 50 GW by the end of 2026, and Jinko's N-type TOPCon capacity exceeding 60 GW

findings.claim: 中國多晶矽廠商推動協調性「自律」減產與整合，加上出口退稅取消，帶動模組價格在2025Q4至2026H1轉為上漲，顯示部分供給紀律正在形成
findings.source: 搜尋摘要（surgepv／pv-magazine-india 2026年太陽能供應鏈報導）
findings.excerpt: Module prices increased in Q4 2025 and continued to face upward pressure in H1 2026, driven by a combination of Chinese supply-side rationalization, production discipline, consolidation in the polysilicon sector, and the removal of China's photovoltaic export tax rebate.

findings.claim: 美國同業Qcells在喬治亞州Cartersville廠已開始生產矽晶太陽能電池，3.5GW電池線預計2026年第三季達全產能，屬美國本土新增產能
findings.excerpt: Qcells has begun manufacturing silicon solar cells at its integrated factory in Cartersville, Georgia, and expects to reach full production of the 3.5-GW cell line by Q3 2026

findings.claim: 美國同業T1 Energy 2026年模組產量預計3.1-4.2GW（2025年為2.79GW），德州Milam County的2.1GW電池廠第一期預計2026年第四季開始投產，屬未來12-24個月內的新增美國本土產能
findings.excerpt: We produced 2.79 GW of modules in 2025. We expect to manufacture between 3.1 and 4.2GW of modules this year... Phase 1 will be a 2.1-gigawatt fab...we remain on track to begin cell production in the fourth quarter of 2026.

cyclical_supply_discipline_capacity.note: 全球c-Si（晶矽）同業整體仍偏擴產、供給紀律有限，但中國多晶矽端出現協調自律訊號；對FSLR更直接的是美國本土同業（Qcells、T1 Energy）2026年內都有新產能開出，侵蝕FSLR過去仰賴的美國本土製造優勢。
